summary: Post-market review (2026-08-21, Friday): US equities held a cautious stance (total risk score 45.58, caution band) but improved modestly intraday versus yesterday (trend_1d +0.59, trend_1w +2.7). The macro dimension remains the dominant pressure source (score 60.27) with the real rate at 2.35 (96.88th percentile over 5 years) and the 10Y yield at 4.69 (97.68th percentile) holding at restrictive highs; a weaker dollar (index 118.90) eased financial conditions marginally. Sharp sector rotation: Quantum Computing +4.98%, EV Supply Chain +4.28% and AI Software +2.58% led, while Semiconductor Equipment -0.65%, Semiconductors -0.44%, Data Centers -1.37% and AI Infrastructure -0.24% lagged; NVDA -0.98%, MU -0.77% and AVGO +1.21% diverged while TSLA +5.14% outperformed alone. Crypto rallied across the board (BTC +6.57%, ETH +5.39%, SOL +4.96%), signaling renewed risk appetite. Low volatility (VIX 16.01, realized vol 13.18) is supportive, but cross-asset confirmation is only 0.375 and breadth is narrow (new-highs ratio 5.16%, 65.81% of stocks above MA200), capping upside.

top_risk_drivers.claim: The macro dimension scores 60.27, the highest of six, with the real rate at 2.35 (96.88th percentile) and the 10Y yield at 4.69 (97.68th percentile) holding at restrictive highs, the primary risk driver.

Cross-asset confirmation is only 0.375 and breadth is narrow: the new-highs ratio is 5.16% while 65.81% of stocks are above MA200; semis relative performance is -3.98%, showing risk signals are not confirmed across assets.
Liquidity buffer is thinning: reverse repo at 0.2 (0.96th percentile, near the floor), with HY OAS at 2.75 and IG OAS at 0.82 — credit spreads calm but fragile.

Sharp internal divergence: Quantum Computing +4.98% and AI Software +2.58% strengthened while Semiconductors -0.44%, Data Centers -1.37% and AI Infrastructure -0.24% weakened, showing rotation rather than breadth; volatility is low (VIX 16.01) but diverges from elevated macro rates (real rate 2.35).

supporting_signals.claim: Crypto rallied across the board: BTC +6.57%, ETH +5.39%, SOL +4.96%, signaling renewed risk appetite.
Low volatility (VIX 16.01, realized vol 13.18) and a positive price trend (price 8.22% above MA200, 3-month momentum 3.10%) are jointly supportive.
A weaker dollar (index 118.90, at the 21.53rd percentile) eased global financial conditions marginally.

contradicting_signals.claim: The elevated macro risk (real rate 2.35, 10Y 4.69) diverges from low volatility (VIX 16.01): market stress pricing and rate pressure are inconsistent.
Cross-asset confirmation is only 0.375 despite a positive price trend (8.22% above MA200), showing risk signals lack cross-asset corroboration.

TSLA +5.14% led the autos chain; AI Software +2.58% and Quantum Computing +4.98% led themes.

bull_case.title: Bull case: rates ease and risk appetite persists
points: Low volatility (VIX 16.01) and positive momentum (price 8.22% above MA200) support multiple expansion.
If the real rate eases from 2.35, macro pressure (60.27) abates and crypto and growth extend gains.
A weaker dollar (118.90) eases global financial conditions and pulls foreign flows back to risk assets.

base_case.title: Base case: caution band holds
points: Restrictive highs — real rate 2.35 and 10Y yield 4.69 — cap upside.
Narrow breadth (new-highs ratio 5.16%) and cross-asset confirmation of 0.375 keep risk range-bound.
Watch the 2026-08-26 catalysts — Nvidia earnings, PCE and GDP — for risk repricing.

bear_case.title: Bear case: rates reprice and liquidity drains
points: If the real rate breaks above 2.35 and the 10Y yield rises above 4.69, with reverse repo at 0.2 near the floor, the equity structure (44.06) and risk assets come under pressure.
Semis relative performance of -3.98% signals rotation into defensives; if cross-asset confirmation of 0.375 slips further, risk appetite reverses.
